name: node-identity
description: Registry of all known hives — self and peers. Updated by talkback.mjs on each ping. Used by dispatcher.mjs to route packages to the correct hive.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: Base URL of the hive's Zo Space (e.g. https://telechurch.zo.space)

fields.name: api_token_env
fields.description: Name of the env var holding this node's Zo API token (e.g. ZO_COMPUTER_TELECHURCH)

fields.name: secret_name
fields.description: Zo Secret name for factory talkback (e.g. FACTORY_TALKBACK_SECRET) — the VALUE is never stored

fields.name: last_seen_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 of last successful talkback ping

fields.name: added_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 when this node was first registered
